query: The project will finance the construction and rehabilitation of classrooms and schools and equip them.
Schools and universities will be connected to broadband internet under the project.
The project will rehabilitate and equip health centres and hospitals in the target districts.
Health facilities will be provided with internet connectivity and solar power.
Ministries, departments and agencies will be connected to the government network and their offices upgraded.
The project will construct and equip municipal offices and local government service centres.
The project will establish and equip emergency operations centres for the disaster management agency and upgrade the meteorological service.
Farmer organisations and cooperatives will receive equipment, training and matching grants through the project.
Agricultural extension offices will be rehabilitated and equipped to deliver services to farmers.
Unelectrified schools and health facilities will be connected to the grid or equipped with solar systems.
